1#main: In which garments they bury, and a man does not dress a woman. In it are 4 seifim. One does not bury the dead in expensive shrouds, even for a prince in Israel.
2#main: The custom is to bury in white garments.
3#main: A man does not wrap and tie the woman, but a woman wraps and ties the man.
4#main: They close the eyes of the dead; and if his mouth opened, they tie his cheeks and plug his orifices after they wash him with kinds of fragrant spices and shave his hair: {Rama: And his nails; and they wash him well in every place so he be clean of all impurity (Binyamin Zev); and they anoint his head with beaten eggs in their shells, for the world revolves like a wheel (Kol Bo).}
